metadata.title: How AlgoCoach Works — Learn, Practice, Assess, Review
metadata.description: See how AlgoCoach connects guided learning, practice, assessment, and review—and how that differs from grind-only problem banks.

hero.title: More than grinding— a full algorithm learning loop
hero.description: AlgoCoach connects approach building, code practice, independent assessment, and personalized review in one workspace with a clear next step every time.

introduce.title: Four stages, one path
introduce.description: Each stage keeps the learner in control and grounds feedback in inspectable evidence.

items.title: Learn: build the approach
items.description: Move from concepts to direction without dumping the full answer.

items.title: Practice: run code
items.description: Execute JavaScript or Python in the browser and inspect real tests.

items.title: Assess: verify independently
items.description: Timed, no-AI checks measure what you actually retained.

items.title: Review: reinforce weak patterns
items.description: Mistakes and hint usage become cards and progress insights.

benefits.title: Key differences from grind-only platforms
benefits.description: AlgoCoach optimizes for the next step—not just whether a submission passed.

items.title: Evidence-driven AI feedback
items.description: Diagnoses cite compile errors, runtime output, and failing tests.

items.title: Guest-first by design
items.description: Experience the full loop before creating an account.

items.title: Syncable learning state
items.description: Sign in to incrementally sync practice, assessments, and review.

features.title: How the pieces fit together
features.description: From first visit to long-term progress, every module shares one learning state.

items.title: Versioned catalog
items.description: Problems are pinned by slug and contentVersion for consistent practice and assessment.

items.title: Daily plans
items.description: Tasks combine goals, weak topics, and due review items.

items.title: Privacy-aware funnel metrics
items.description: Teams can observe conversion without collecting problem text or code.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Common questions about how AlgoCoach works.

items.question: How is this different from LeetCode?
items.answer: AlgoCoach emphasizes guided hints, evidence-based diagnosis, and review loops—not just pass rate.

items.question: Which AI models are used?
items.answer: The server connects through an OpenAI-compatible relay; exact models depend on deployment.

items.question: Where is data stored?
items.answer: Guest data stays in the browser; signed-in users can sync to a PostgreSQL-backed account.

cta.title: Experience the full loop on one problem
cta.description: Start with a guided practice problem and see how learn, practice, assess, and review connect.
